g.text: An answer, a confidence judgment, and the option to pass
Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct · 128 questions × 4 answer rotations · 95% question-bootstrap intervals
Middle: labels count variants; sparse bins can lack intervals. Right: five folds grouped by question; intervals conditional on fitted predictors.
External predictors: published difficulty, question embeddings and answer position. The confidence report is not supplied to the abstention stage.
